policies.execution: serial, one attempt per case, no retries, redirects disabled by http.client harness path
policies.lifecycle: Per-application target start/stop for each case; stop must prove quiet or campaign stops
policies.measurement: raw response bytes, request body bytes, application lifecycle, audit path, same-invocation coverage and gcov denominator links are recorded
policies.resources: fresh physical resources every case through P2b fixture registry; DD bindings reset in the isolated invocation environment
policies.resume: --resume loads prior receipts and constructs a subset containing only never-attempted case IDs; failed attempts are not replayed
policies.stopPolicy: transport/deadline/startup/lifecycle quietness stops; experimental expectation/structural violations are recorded and execution continues; measurement inadmissibility is recorded without fake zero

prerequisites.coverage: uses unified-preflight-v3 coverage helpers; gcov errors/stamp mismatches/missing denominator are inadmissible, never fake zero
prerequisites.frozenSuites: parent-supplied absolute suite paths required; this runner does not generate or invent T1/T2/T3/T4
prerequisites.officialReadiness: execute requires an explicit readiness JSON with officialReady=true and campaignAuthorized=true
prerequisites.oraclePolicy: no evaluation-quarantine/model expected-output files are read by this runner during plan/execute

python.reason: jsonschema/PyYAML qualified environment; do not use system python3 for campaign wrapper

scope: plan only; no API/COBOL execution in plan mode
